problem: P1 - Requests have no owner and no state of record; they die silently
headline_evidence: 159/200 requests are unresolved with 30+ days of silence ($106,480,000 of pipeline); 115/200 have no connector of record; 111/200 have no state evidence beyond a self-declared status field

problem: P2 - The record of truth contradicts itself; 'no path' is often false
headline_evidence: 150/200 requests carry at least one contradiction; 46/109 requests declared no-path/unknown have a connection to the account pre-dating the request

problem: P3 - Path discovery is manual, so known paths go unused
headline_evidence: 97/200 requests had a time-aware path; roster connectors sat on 220/263 request-paths they were never asked about

problem: P4 - Duplicate and repeat asks collide on the same accounts
headline_evidence: 42/200 asks say in their own text that they are repeats; 200 requests cover only 51 accounts

problem: P5 - Entity resolution is unreliable across sources
headline_evidence: 94/200 requests name a target that does not resolve cleanly to a CRM account; 6 CRM domain pairs are near-duplicates
only 2/49 connector-months exceed the connector's own stated capacity; recorded asks are far below stated capacity
